Join compound_structures INNER JOIN on compound_structures.molregno = metabolism.substrate_record_id
Join molecule_dictionary substrate_dict INNER JOIN on substrate_dict.molregno = metabolism.substrate_record_id
Join molecule_dictionary parent_dict LEFT JOIN on parent_dict.molregno = metabolism.met_id

Filter enzyme_dict.pref_name = 'CYP2B6'

Limit 200"
